name: OmniQoL
description: All-in-one modular Quality of Life suite for Pokémon native recompilations (Gen 1: Red, Blue, Yellow; Gen 2: Gold, Silver, Crystal). Features Running Shoes across Gen 1 and Gen 2 (with Pikachu follower sync on Yellow), modern Gen 6+ EXP Share, Trade Evolutions at Lv. 40, Catch All 151 Pokémon, Move Relearner in all Pokémon Centers, and freely replaceable HM moves, all with native Options Menu integration.
